card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 with NO IMEI due to shorted baseband

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 16 with NO IMEI due to shorted baseband

claims.statement: iPhone 16-series with no IMEI / modem firmware missing can have PP_3V1_LDO10 shorted to ground (near 0 Ω) under the baseband CPU; the short clears when the BB CPU is lifted.
Fix: remove the baseband CPU, insulate the PP_3V1_LDO10 pad on the board with UV mask or polyimide, then reball and refit the BB CPU.
Injecting 1–3 V with a current limit makes the baseband CPU area heat, confirming the location.

procedure: Inspect the baseband area for rework or liquid.
Measure PP_3V1_LDO10 to ground near the BB CPU.
Remove underfill, preheat, lift BB CPU; recheck the short.
Mask the PP_3V1_LDO10 pad, reball and refit BB CPU.
card.caveats: Specialist repair; baseband CPU is paired to the board. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
